project: Wuxia Life P87 Medical Pressure Playable Implementation
description: Playable implementation of medical_sage_healer pressure stage following P86 design-first contract, covering both compassionate (burnout) and pragmatic (favor debt) variants with tavern-born healer flavor preserved.

userStories.title: Wire medical pressure spine events (2 variants)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the medical pressure events (2 variants) wired through the existing event system so players on the medical route encounter real pressure milestones.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure medical_pressure_compassionate auto event in sample-lines-spine.json
Configure medical_pressure_pragmatic auto event in sample-lines-spine.json
Compassionate triggers: medical_on_ramp_done + tavern_medical_on_ramp_compassionate + age 36-40 + exclusivity guard
Pragmatic triggers: medical_on_ramp_done + tavern_medical_on_ramp_pragmatic + age 37-41 + exclusivity guard
Both events set shared medical_midlife_pressure_done checkpoint flag
Compassionate sets tavern_medical_pressure_compassionate variant marker
Pragmatic sets tavern_medical_pressure_pragmatic variant marker
Compassionate stats: constitution -3, reputation +3, chivalry +2
Pragmatic stats: reputation +4, connections +3, charisma +2, money +50
No new event framework or scheduler introduced
No P83/P84/P85 regressions
userStories.notes: Core runtime wiring — 2 auto events following P86 contract. Both variants share checkpoint flag but have distinct markers and effects.

Sample line current goal update for both variants (on-ramp → pressure)
Ordinary origin current goal update for both variants (on-ramp → pressure)
At least 2 pressure-specific readable signals per variant (cost label + current goal)

No new UI components
userStories.notes: P0 expression updates — 3 surfaces × 2 variants = 6 total updates. Must maintain variant differentiation and tavern-born flavor.

userStories.title: Add targeted pressure proof (2 variants)
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want bounded proof artifacts showing that both medical pressure variants fire correctly and carry the tavern-born healer flavor.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce 1 targeted proof document covering both variants (on-ramp → pressure path validation)
Compassionate: show 6 core nodes (pre-pressure state → event fires → checkpoint set → variant marker → cost label → current goal)
Pragmatic: show 6 core nodes (pre-pressure state → event fires → checkpoint set → variant marker → cost label → current goal)
Optional bonus nodes: life memory, summary, full chain trace (bridge → entry → on-ramp → pressure)
No full lifetime exhaust required
Proof supports judgment on whether to continue to payoff stage
Save as docs/test-reports/p87-medical-pressure-targeted-proof.md
userStories.notes: ~12 core proof nodes (6 per variant) + optional bonus nodes. Serves as GO/NO-GO evidence for P88 payoff stage.

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests guarding the medical pressure stage (2 variants) so future edits do not break the first medical pressure milestone.

Group 4: Variant differentiation (4 tests) — 2 variants are different
Group 5: Cross-route distinction (3 tests) — different from merchant/renown

Reuse existing test harness
All relevant commands pass
